subject.title: Track Usage & Spend production hardening and sharing follow-ups

question: Should the project retain the staged order of renderer and partial-history correctness first, independent CI isolation second, then product approval for the dashboard/share-artifact split before native sharing or the draft redesign proceeds?
rationale: The remaining work is not one implementation defect: it includes a new sharing capability and a durable information-architecture decision whose acceptable product contract cannot be inferred from tests alone.

options.title: Keep the staged sequence
options.body: Land the narrow correctness and CI pull requests first, then approve a stable data and visual contract before accepting redesign or native-sharing work.

options.title: Sponsor native sharing now
options.body: Explicitly approve native sharing as a separate artifact-preserving feature while keeping the dashboard redesign independently scoped.

options.title: Defer both product streams
options.body: Close or pause the draft redesign and native-sharing direction until a maintainer wants to sponsor the broader Usage & Spend roadmap.

recommendation.title: Keep the staged sequence
recommendation.body: Land the narrow correctness and CI pull requests first, then approve a stable data and visual contract before accepting redesign or native-sharing work.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice sets the permanent product boundary and release order for a repository-level macOS feature surface.
